name: writing-register
description: Make Claude Code write like a careful colleague. The humanizer patterns, and your own voice if you set one, steer every session and subagent; hooks rewrite commit messages, PR descriptions and markdown by themselves; wr humanize rewrites a document and checks each changed sentence against the code. The hooks need the wr command: uv tool install git+https://github.com/pablogiaccaglia/writing-register
